title: The compatible fibre stalk of an affine principal hypersurface
statement: Let $g:Y\to S$ be any morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $s\in S$, and $y$ a closed point [def-weil-closed-points] of its scheme-theoretic fibre $F=Y_s$ [def-pc-scheme-fibre]. Put $x=\iota_s(y)$ for the fibre projection $\iota_s:F\to Y$. Let $U\subseteq Y$ be an affine open neighbourhood [def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-affine-spectrum] of $x$, write $B=\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_Y)$, and let $a\in B$. Let $b\in A=\mathcal O_{F,y}$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] be the image of the germ $a_x$ under the induced local ring map [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism] $\iota_s^\sharp_y$. Assume $b$ lies in the maximal ideal of $A$. Set $D=\operatorname{Spec}(B/(a))$, with the canonical map $i:D\to Y$ through $U$. There exist a closed point $y_D\in D_s$ and an equality $h:(\iota_{D,s};i)(y_D)=x$, together with a ring isomorphism $e:\mathcal O_{D_s,y_D}\cong A/(b)$ such that for every $z\in\mathcal O_{Y,x}$, $e((\iota_{D,s};i)^\sharp_{y_D}(h^*z))$ is the image of $\iota_s^\sharp_y(z)$ in $A/(b)$; here $h^*$ is the canonical identification of stalks along $h$. No flatness, regularity, Noetherian or dimension assumption is imposed.

proof.text: Write $F=Y_s$, $A=\mathcal O_{F,y}$ and $b$ for the image in $A$ of the germ of $a$. Let $D=\operatorname{Spec}(B/(a))$, $E=D_s$ and let $j:E\to F$ be the morphism induced by the fibre universal property. Its composite with $F\to Y$ is the composite $E\to D\to Y$ of preimmersions: a fibre projection, the spectrum of a quotient map and an affine open immersion. Thus $j$ is injective and surjective on stalks: injectivity follows from injectivity of this composite, and surjectivity follows because each stalk map of the composite factors through the corresponding stalk map of $j$.

source.place: Tag 0570, lemma-slice-CM, positive-dimensional case: the assertion O_{D_s,x} = O_{X_s,x}/(hbar); Schemes Tags 01JU and 0HA1; Algebra Tag 00CT.

proof.text: The ideal $(b)$ is contained in the maximal ideal of the local ring $A$, so $Q=A/(b)$ is nonzero and local, and its quotient map $q:A\to Q$ is local. Compose $B\to A\to Q$. This kills $a$, so factors through $B/(a)$. Its spectrum defines $\operatorname{Spec}Q\to D$. By the affine description of the canonical local-ring morphism and naturality on stalks, its composite to $Y$ is $\operatorname{Spec}Q\to F\to Y$. The fibre universal property therefore gives $r:\operatorname{Spec}Q\to E$ with $jr$ equal to the canonical map to $F$. Its closed point gives $y_D$ with $j(y_D)=y$. Since $j$ is injective, $j^{-1}(\{y\})=\{y_D\}$; continuity and the assumed closedness of $y$ prove that $y_D$ is closed.

source.place: Tag 0570, lemma-slice-CM, positive-dimensional case: the assertion O_{D_s,x} = O_{X_s,x}/(hbar); Schemes Tags 01JU and 0HA1; Algebra Tag 00CT.

proof.text: Let $v:A\to C=\mathcal O_{E,y_D}$ be the surjective pointed stalk map of $j$, with the equality $j(y_D)=y$ incorporated by stalkCongr. The map $B\to C$ factors through $B/(a)$ by taking the affine-spectrum preimage of $\operatorname{Spec}C\to E\to D$. Naturality of the maps from spectra of stalks shows that this map is $B\to A\xrightarrow{v}C$, so $v(b)=0$. The local stalk map of $r$ gives $\psi:C\to Q$ with $\psi v=q$, again by naturality and the equality $jr=\operatorname{Spec}(q)\circ\operatorname{Spec}(A)\to F$. Hence $(b)\subseteq\ker(v)\subseteq\ker(q)=(b)$. The surjective ring-map first isomorphism theorem gives $e:C\cong A/(b)$ with $e(v(z))=q(z)$. The pointed stalk map from $Y$ equals $v$ composed with the stalk map to $F$, because their spectra become the same map after composition with the monomorphism $\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{Y,x}\to Y$. This yields the required compatibility formula for every $z\in\mathcal O_{Y,x}$.

theorem exists_closed_fiber_point_principal_stalk_equiv
    {Y S : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ S) (s : S) (y : g.fiber s)
    (hy : y ∈ closedPoints (g.fiber s))
    (U : Y.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (hx : g.fiberι s y ∈ U) (a : Γ(Y, U))
    (hb : (g.fiberι s).stalkMap y (Y.presheaf.germ U (g.fiberι s y) hx a) ∈
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((g.fiber s).presheaf.stalk y)) :
    let i := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {a}))) ≫
      hU.fromSpec
    let b := (g.fiberι s).stalkMap y (Y.presheaf.germ U (g.fiberι s y) hx a)
    ∃ (yD : (i ≫ g).fiber s)
      (hyD : ((i ≫ g).fiberι s ≫ i) yD = g.fiberι s y),
      yD ∈ closedPoints ((i ≫ g).fiber s) ∧
      ∃ e : ((i ≫ g).fiber s).presheaf.stalk yD ≃+*
          ((g.fiber s).presheaf.stalk y ⧸ Ideal.span {b}),
        ∀ r : Y.presheaf.stalk (g.fiberι s y),
          e (((i ≫ g).fiberι s ≫ i).stalkMap yD
            ((Y.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hyD)).inv r)) =
            Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {b}) ((g.fiberι s).stalkMap y r)
